title: These Are The U.S. States With The Most Paranormal Activity, Per TripSIM Analysis
excerpt: From Bigfoot reports to UFO sightings, these are the states that have seen the most paranormal activity.
content:
We all love an unexplained story -- especially around this time of year -- and those looking to plan a trip to explore potential paranormal activity don't have to look very far. There are plenty of paranormal stories across the U.S., with some states standing out more than others for their haunted locations, Bigfoot reports, and UFO sightings.

A new analysis by TripSIM has found the states that have the most reported paranormal activity. The study looked at things like Reddit mentions of paranormal experiences, the number of psychics, and reported UFO sightings.

These were the top five U.S. states with the most reported paranormal activity:

Wyoming

Wyoming earned first place in the analysis with a composite score of 67.07 out of 100. The state recorded the highest number of haunted-location listings in the study as well as 76.34 reported UFO sightings per 100,000 people and 4.74 Bigfoot reports.

Vermont

Vermont came in second place with an overall score of 66.05 out of 100. It recorded particularly high rates of reported UFO sightings, with 103.30 sightings per 100,000 residents. It also had 7.31 haunted-location listings per 100,000 people.

Oregon

In third place is Oregon with a score of 62.06 out of 100. It had a significant amount of Bigfoot folklore with 6.12 Bigfoot reports per 100,000 residents. It also had a relatively high number of UFO sightings at 89.80 reports per 100,000 residents.

Washington

Washington earned fourth place largely thanks to its high number of Bigfoot reports. It had the highest rate in the study with 9.09 sightings per 100,000 residents. The association with Bigfoot folklore and moody mountainous and forested landscapes (plus Twilight, hello), makes Washington a standout for paranormal folklore and nostalgic autumnal travel alike.

Montana

Montana hit fifth place with a composite score of 58.74 out of 100. The state recorded 95.15 reported UFO sightings per 100,000 residents and 7.48 Bigfoot reports per 100,000 people as well. It also has an impressive 455 Reddit mentions of paranormal experiences per 100,000 residents.

This article was originally published on Forbes.com
